name: rit-plugin
description: Rit's grounded explanation, evidence-based learning, and deterministic change-report workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Rit's explanation, learning, and change-report workflows.
interface.longDescription: Grounded technical explanation, evidence-based long-term learning, and deterministic standalone HTML change reports in one personal workflow bundle.
defaultPrompt: Use $grounded-explainer to explain why a concept exists from a concrete scenario, then deepen only as needed.
Use $learn to build durable capability through evidence-based practice.
Use $change-report to summarize a selected diff and render a standalone HTML change report.
